Amethyst uses Health Connect to build My Fitness — your own training summary, on your phone.

My Fitness (menu → You → My Fitness) shows you how you have been training: how much you did this week against last week, how your time splits across running, cycling, walking, swimming and the gym, your best efforts, how many days you trained, and your current streak. Amethyst builds that picture from the workouts your watch or fitness app already saved to Health Connect, together with any workouts you logged in Amethyst itself. It is worked out on your phone and shown to you.

Exercise · which activity you did, when it started and how long it lasted. This is the workout itself: it drives your workout count, your training time, the per-activity breakdown, your active days and your streak.
Distance · how far you went, shown as your distance this week against last week, your weekly average, your distance per activity, and your longest distance.

Active and total calories · the energy a workout burned, shown as your energy this week and how it compares with last week. Active calories are used when your source records them; total calories are the fallback for sources that only record total energy.
Heart rate · the average and maximum over each workout, combined into your average and highest heart rate for the period. It is how you tell an easy week from a hard one at the same distance.
Steps · the step count of a run, walk or hike, shown as your weekly step average and your highest step count.
Elevation gained · how much you climbed, shown as your weekly climb average and your biggest climb. It is what separates a flat week from a hilly one.
Only reads workouts from the last 4 weeks, and only while My Fitness or the workout composer is open. It never reads in the background.
Never writes anything to Health Connect, and never asks for your exercise route, location or any other health data type.

Never sends your health data anywhere. My Fitness is worked out on your phone and stays there. If you later want to post one workout, you tap Share on that workout, read the post Amethyst filled in, and publish it yourself — one workout at a time, never automatically.

The whole feature is optional. Revoke the permissions in Health Connect at any time — My Fitness drops back to its prompt — or turn the composer suggestions off under Settings → Compose Settings. The rest of Amethyst keeps working.
